page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs using the x86_64 architecture, running on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput data transfers. The dedicated CPU allocation model ensures that each vCPU corresponds to a physical core with one thread per core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

Given the high density of dedicated Intel Xeon cores and 1 TB of system memory, this instance represents a high-resource tier designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. The lack of local storage and GPU hardware makes it cost-efficient specifically for workloads that require massive memory capacity and high network throughput without needing local disk IOPS or hardware acceleration. Suitable workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy memory-bound data processing, and large-scale virtualization.
